We urge you to look past the selectively leaked, out-of-context memo in recent press reports, which relies on cherry-picked worst-case scenarios while ignoring the vital grid-balancing tools actually funded by the National Clean Energy Transition Act. The true threat to American energy reliability is clinging to our aging, fragile infrastructure that is already failing during extreme weather, not the modernization this legislation accelerates.
